sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Welcome to iziTools. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency about how we handle your data. This Privacy Policy explains our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of information when you use our website.

subsections.title: Data Processed Locally
subsections.content: iziTools is designed with privacy in mind. Most of our tools process data entirely in your browser, meaning your data never leaves your device.
points: Your input data is processed in your browser
No data is sent to our servers
No data is stored on our systems
We have no access to your data

subsections.title: Automatically Collected Information
subsections.content: Like most websites, we automatically collect certain information when you visit iziTools:
subsections.note: This information is used for analytics purposes to improve our services and is collected through standard web analytics tools.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
points: Analyze usage patterns to enhance our tools
Ensure website security and prevent abuse

sections.title: Third-Party Services
sections.content: We may use third-party services that have their own privacy policies:

services.name: Analytics
services.description: We use web analytics services to understand how visitors use our site

services.name: Advertising
services.description: We may display advertisements through third-party ad networks

services.name: Hosting
services.description: Our website is hosted on Cloudflare Pages

sections.note: These services may collect information according to their own privacy policies. We encourage you to review their privacy practices.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.content: We may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience. Cookies are small data files stored on your device. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

cookieTypes.name: Essential cookies
cookieTypes.description: Required for the website to function properly

cookieTypes.name: Analytics cookies
cookieTypes.description: Help us understand how visitors interact with our site

cookieTypes.name: Preference cookies
cookieTypes.description: Remember your settings (e.g., dark mode preference)

sections.title: Data Security
sections.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information:
rights: Right to access your personal data
Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
sections.note: To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information provided in the Contact section.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
sections.content: Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected information from a child, please contact us immediately.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes.
